corpus: 138 same-language TourAPI documents; unselected documents unchanged
selection: fixed 30 shortage-priority fact-language items from existing allocation; same facts in all three conditions
field_max: encode each field_text separately; document score is max of base document cosine and each field cosine; changes retrieval scoring as well as text structure
query_set: 57 AI-drafted development queries; selected by direct enrichment availability and already observed results; no independence
budget_unit: 30 facts, not equal tokens or costs
limitations: labels require independent human review; multiple relevant places unjudged; document-length and max score effects; results not causal or independently generalizable
